summary: Ignore fork repositories in GitHub coverage audit

delivery.outcome: Make the read-only GitHub coverage audit detect repository forks before issue enumeration, exclude confirmed forks from totals, and retain explicit metadata failures.
nonGoals: No GitHub repository, Issue, Planfile, or remote state is modified.
No repository discovery rules outside the audit report are changed.
No runtime dependency or external service is added.

architecture.decision: Use gh repo view --json isFork as a fail-closed metadata gate before gh issue list; omit confirmed forks from normal repository aggregates while retaining a bounded ignored_forks inventory.
interfaceChanges: Adds ignored_fork_count and ignored_forks fields to the audit JSON report.
architecture.rollback: Revert this ticket branch; the audit remains read-only and no remote repository data is changed.

validation.evidence: Fork metadata gating, unknown metadata, non-fork behavior, and report fields are covered by tests.
The managed governance gate and full Python test suite pass.
